Description: Upon receipt of a No-Op command, DS shall increment the DS Valid Command Counter and generate an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Debug command to verify application is alive.

Description:
Upon receipt of a Reset Counters command, DS shall reset the following housekeeping variables to a value of zero:
a) Valid Command Counter
b) Command Rejected Counter
c) Packets discarded (DS was disabled) Counter
d) Packets discarded (pkt has no filter) Counter
e) Packets discarded (failed filter test) Counter
f) Packets that passed filter test Counter
g) Good destination file I/O Counter
h) Bad destination file I/O Counter
i) Good updates to secondary header Counter
j) Bad updates to secondary header Counter
k) Destination file table loads Counter
l) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
m) Packet filter table loads Counter
n) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
Requirement Rationale:
Important for testing and on-orbit flight operations in order to start with
a “clean slate”.

Description: For all DS commands, if the length contained in the message header is not equal to the expected length, DS shall reject the command and issue an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Basic command verification in the event of SEU or memory corruption

Description: If DS accepts any command as valid, DS shall execute the command, increment the DS Valid Command Counter and issue an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Operators require feedback on command execution.

Description: If DS rejects any command, DS shall abort the command execution, increment the DS Command Rejected Counter and issue an error event message.
Requirement Rationale: Operators require feedback on command execution.

Description: Upon receipt of a message, if the Packet Processing State is ENABLED, DS shall determine if the message shall be stored based on the contents of the Packet Filter Table and the Destination File Table.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies source for message storage criteria configuration

Summary: DS: Message Storage Determination - Packet Filter Table Contents
Description:
The Packet Filter Table contents shall include:
a) Message ID
b) Destination file table index
c) Filter type (time/sequence count)
d) Algorithm N value
e) Algorithm X value 
f) Algorithm O value
Requirement Rationale: Specifies minimum packet filter table contents which support operational configuration management

Summary: DS: Message Storage Determination - Destination File Table Contents
Description:
The Destination File Table contents shall include:
a) Pathname
b) Basename
c) Extension
d) Filename type (time/sequence)
e) Default Destination enable state
f) Max file size (in bytes)
g) Max file age (in seconds) 
h) Initial Sequence Count
Requirement Rationale: Specifies minimum Destination File Table contents which support operational configuration management

Summary: DS: N Of X Filter Algorithm
Description: DS shall store "N of X" messages starting at offset O.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies storage filtering method

Summary: DS: N Of X Filter Algorithm - Zero N Or X Value
Description: If either the X value or the N value is zero, then the message shall not be stored.
Requirement Rationale: Gracefully handle "0" parameters and provide a way to specify no storage.

Summary: DS: Multiple Destination Files Per Message
Description: DS shall store each message in up to <PLATFORM_DEFINED> different destination files.
Requirement Rationale: Support platform configuration of maximum number of files to store a message to

Summary: DS: Multiple Destination Files Per Message - Destination File Creation
Description: Destination files shall be created when the first message is received that is passed by the filter algorithm for that particular message and selects that particular destination file.
Requirement Rationale: Preserve space and create files only as needed.

Description: The input argument to the filter algorithm shall be determined by the Filter Type indicator.
Requirement Rationale: Supports selectable filter type with unique input arguments

Summary: DS: Filter Algorithm Input Argument - Sequence Based Filtering
Description: If Filter Type indicates Sequence based filtering then the algorithm input argument is a value equal to the packet sequence count.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies sequence based filtering input argument

Summary: DS: Filter Algorithm Input Argument - Time Based Filtering
Description: If Filter Type indicates Time based filtering then the algorithm input argument is a value created from the lower 11 bits of packet timestamp seconds plus the high 4 bits of timestamp subseconds.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies time based filtering input argument

Description: DS shall construct unique filenames using either sequence count or time as selected within the Destination File Table.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies operational control via table of unique data file name generation method.

Summary: DS: Unique Filename Construction - Sequence Based Naming
Description: If Filename Type indicates naming based on Sequence the constructed filename will include a character representation of the Sequence Count value from the Destination File Table.
Requirement Rationale: Unique file name generation using the file sequence count

Summary: DS: Unique Filename Construction - Sequence Based Naming - Sequence Count Increment
Description: If Filename Type indicates naming based on Sequence the value of Sequence Count shall be incremented each time a file is created.
Requirement Rationale: Sequence count behavior based on file creation

Summary: DS: Unique Filename Construction - Time Based Naming
Description: If Filename Type indicates naming based on Time the constructed filename will include a character representation of the packet timestamp.
Requirement Rationale: Unique file name construction based on time

Summary: DS: Unique Filename Construction - Time Based Naming - Time Format
Description: If Filename Type indicates naming based on Time the file date and time shall be represented in the following format: "YYYYDDDHHMMSS".
Requirement Rationale: Time format for unique file name creation

Description: Prior to writing a packet to an existing destination file, DS shall verify that the resulting file size (after the write) shall not exceed the file size limit as defined in the Destination File Table.
Requirement Rationale: Destination file size limit enforcement method

Summary: DS: Destination File Size Limit - Close And Open New File
Description: If the resulting file size would exceed the file size limit then DS shall close the existing file and open another file.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies behavior when reaching the destination file size limit

Summary: DS: Destination File Size Limit - Minimum One Packet Per File
Description: A minimum of one packet shall be written to a file
Requirement Rationale: Preserve space and create files only as needed.

Description: Periodically, DS shall test the age of all open destination files. If any file age exceeds the maximum age defined for that file in the Destination File Table, then DS shall close the file.
Requirement Rationale: Destination file age limit enforcement

Summary: DS: Destination File Age Limit - Age Update Rate
Description: DS shall update file age and test age limits every time DS processes its housekeeping telemetry request command.
Requirement Rationale: Specifies rate for destination file age limit check

Description:
Each DS destination file shall contain a primary cFE file header with the following information: 
a) Content Type 
b) SubType 
c) Primary header length 
d) Spacecraft ID 
e) Processor ID 
f) Application ID 
g) File creation time (seconds) 
h) File creation time (sub-seconds)
Requirement Rationale: Standard cFE file header

Description:
Each DS destination file shall contain a secondary file header with the following information:
a) File close time (seconds)
b) File close time (sub-seconds)
c) File table index
d) Qualified Filename
Requirement Rationale: Destination file secondary file header contents

Description:
For every file write error, DS shall:
a) Send an event message
b) Increment total number of file write errors
c) Close the destination file
d) Disable the destination
Requirement Rationale: Notify operators of error and prevent ongoing future errors caused by writing to the same destination file.

Description: DS shall send a file information telemetry message when closing a data storage file.
Requirement Rationale: Provides file information telemetry packet containing the current status for a closed destination file.

Description:
Upon receipt of a Disable command, DS shall stop filtering and storing messages.
Note: This command will set the Packet Processing State to DISABLED.
Requirement Rationale: Operational control of packet processing state (message storage)

Description:
Upon receipt of an Enable command, DS shall begin filtering and storing messages.
Note: This command will set the Packet Processing State to ENABLED.
Requirement Rationale: Operational control of packet processing state (message storage)

Description: Upon receipt of a Close File command, DS shall close the command-specified destination file.
Requirement Rationale: Operational interface to manually close a single destination file

Description: Upon receipt of a Set File Basename command, DS shall set the file basename for the command-specified destination file.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support to manually set file basename

Summary: DS: Set Next File Sequence Counter Command
Description: Upon receipt of a Set Next File Sequence Counter command, DS shall set the command-specified  file counter for the command-specified Destination File.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support for manual control of the file counter

Description: Upon receipt of an Enable Destination File command, DS shall enable file collection for the command-specified Destination File.
Requirement Rationale: Operational control for managing destination file collection state

Description: Upon receipt of a Disable Destination File command, DS disable file collection for the command-specified Destination File.
Requirement Rationale: Operational control for managing destination file collection state

Description: Upon receipt of a Close All Files command, DS shall close all open destination files.
Requirement Rationale: Operational interface to close every open destination file with a single command

Summary: DS: Set Filter File Index Command
Description: Upon receipt of a Set File Index for a Packet Filter Table entry command, DS shall update the destination file index.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support for setting Packet Filter Table destination file index

Description: Upon receipt of a Set Filter Type for a Packet Filter Table entry command, DS shall update the filter type to the command-specified filter type.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support for setting Packet Filter Table entry filter type

Description: Upon receipt of a Set Filter Parameter for a Packet Filter Table entry command, DS shall update the N, X, O Parameters to the command-specified values
Requirement Rationale: Allow on-orbit modification of filtering parameters without requiring a table update.

Description: Upon receipt of a Set Destination Type for a destination file type command, DS shall update the Destination type to the command-specified destination type.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support for setting file destination type

Description: Upon receipt of a Set Path for a destination filename command, DS shall update the path to the command-specified path.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support to manually set the destination filename path

Description: Upon receipt of a Set Extension for destination filename command, DS shall update the file extension to the command-specified extension.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support to manually set the destination filename extension

Summary: DS: Set Destination File Size Limit Command
Description: Upon receipt of a Set Maximum Size for a destination file command, DS shall update the maximum file size to the command-specified maximum
Requirement Rationale: Operational support to manually set the destination file maximum size

Summary: DS: Set Destination File Age Limit Command
Description: Upon receipt of a Set Maximum Age for a destination file command, DS shall update the maximum destination file age to the command-specified maximum age.
Requirement Rationale: Operational support to manually set destination file maximum age limit

Description: Upon receipt of an Add Message ID to Packet Filter Table command, DS shall add the command-specified Message ID to the next unused entry in the Packet Filter Table.
Requirement Rationale: Allow on-orbit modification of Packet Filter Table without requiring a table update.

Summary: DS: Add Message ID Command - Invalid Message ID
Description: If the command-specified Message ID is invalid DS will reject the command and send an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Response to invalid message id in command

Summary: DS: Add Message ID Command - Filter Table Not Loaded
Description: If the Packet Filter table is not loaded DS will reject the command and send an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Response to command without a loaded Packet Filter table

Summary: DS: Add Message ID Command - Duplicate Message ID
Description: If the command-specified Message ID is already specified in the Packet Filter Table DS will reject the command and send an event message
Requirement Rationale: Response to commanding an already specified message ID in the Packet Filter Table

Summary: DS: Add Message ID Command - Filter Table Full
Description: If there are no unused entries in the Packet Filter Table DS will reject the command and send an event message
Requirement Rationale: Response to a command to add an entry to a full Packet Filter Table

Description:
Upon Receipt of a Get File Info command, DS shall generate a telemetry packet containing the following information for each destination file:
     1) File age
     2) File size
     3) File rate
     4) Sequence count
     5) Enable state
     6) Open state
     7) Filename
Requirement Rationale: Provides information on file status

Description: Upon receipt of a Remove Message ID to Packet Filter Table command, DS shall remove the command-specified Message ID from the Packet Filter Table.
Requirement Rationale: Allow on-orbit modification of Packet Filter Table without requiring a table update.

Summary: DS: Remove Message ID Command - Invalid Message ID
Description: If the command-specified Message ID is invalid DS will reject the command and send an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Allow on-orbit modification of Packet Filter Table without requiring a table update.

Summary: DS: Remove Message ID Command - Filter Table Not Loaded
Description: If the Packet Filter Table is not loaded DS will reject the command and send an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Response to command without a loaded Packet Filter Table.

Summary: DS: Remove Message ID Command - Message ID Not Found
Description: If the command-specified Message ID is not specified in the Packet Filter Table DS will reject the command and send an event message.
Requirement Rationale: Response to commanding a specified message ID that does not exist in the Packet Filter Table.

Description:
DS shall generate a housekeeping message containing the following:
a) Valid Command Counter
b) Command Rejected Counter
c) Packets discarded (DS was disabled) Counter
d) Packets discarded (pkt has no filter) Counter
e) Packets discarded (failed filter test) Counter
f) Packets that passed filter test Counter
g) Good destination file I/O Counter
h) Bad destination file I/O Counter
i) Good updates to secondary header Counter
j) Bad updates to secondary header Counter
k) Destination file table loads Counter
l) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
m) Packet filter table loads Counter
n) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
o) Application State
p) Filename of last loaded Filter Table
Requirement Rationale: Housekeeping telemetry to indicate basic DS status.

Description:
Upon cFE Power-On DS shall initialize the following Housekeeping data to Zero (or value specified):
a) Valid Command Counter
b) Command Rejected Counter
c) Packets discarded (DS was disabled) Counter
d) Packets discarded (pkt has no filter) Counter
e) Packets discarded (failed filter test) Counter
f) Packets that passed filter test Counter
g) Good destination file I/O Counter 
h) Bad destination file I/O Counter
i) Good updates to secondary header Counter
j) Bad updates to secondary header Counter
k) Destination file table loads Counter
l) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
m) Packet filter table loads Counter
n) Failed attempts to get table data pointer Counter
Requirement Rationale: Start from a known "clean" state.

Summary: DS: Load Default Tables On Power-On
Description: Upon cFE Power-On DS shall initialize the DS tables from the default files.
Requirement Rationale: Start from a known "good" state.

Summary: DS: Close All Files On Reset
Description: Upon a cFE Processor Reset or DS Application Reset, DS shall close all files.
Requirement Rationale: Orderly shutdown of files in a reset.

Summary: DS: Reset Restoration With Preserve Flag True
Description:
Upon a cFE Processor Reset or DS Application Reset ,  DS shall restore the following if the associated <PLATFORM_DEFINED> Preserve Flag is set to TRUE:
a) Packet Filter Table
b) Destination File Table
c) File Sequence number for all Destination File Sets
d) Packet Processing State (ENABLED or DISABLED)
Requirement Rationale: Processor or application reset behavior when preserve flag is set to TRUE

Summary: DS: Reset Restoration With Preserve Flag False
Description:
Upon a cFE Processor Reset or DS Application Reset ,  DS shall restore the following if the associated <PLATFORM_DEFINED> Preserve Flag is set to FALSE:
a) File Sequence Counters
b) <PLATFORM_DEFINED> Packet Processing State
Requirement Rationale: Processor or Application reset behavior when Preserve Flag is set to FALSE

Description:
Upon any initialization and/or Packet Filter Table Update, DS shall validate the Packet Filter Table:
a) message ID
b) destination file table index
c) filter type (time/sequence)
d) filter parms (N,X,O)
Requirement Rationale: Validate the items that can be validated when a table is updated (some items cannot be validated until runtime).

Summary: DS: Packet Filter Table Message Subscription
Description: Upon any initialization and/or Packet Filter Table Update, DS shall subscribe to the messages defined in the Data Storage Packet Filter Table.
Requirement Rationale: Must subscribe to all of the messages defined in the Data Storage Packet Filter Table after any reset.

Description:
Upon any initialization and/or Destination File Table Update, DS will validate the Destination File Table:
a) filename type
b) file enable/disable state
c) max file size
d) max file age
e) sequence count
Requirement Rationale: Valid the items that can be validated when a table is updated (some items cannot be validated until runtime).

Description: Upon cFE Power-On DS shall set the Packet Processing State to the <PLATFORM_DEFINED> state (ENABLED or DISABLED).
Requirement Rationale: Power-on reset Packet Processing State behavior
